question: What supreme Eye of Śiva and Śakti is honored as the essence of illumination and total power?
premises: The Eye is identified as supreme.
It belongs to Śiva and Śakti.
It is characterized by illumination and complete power.
inference: The supreme Eye of Śiva and Śakti, essence of illumination and all power, is worthy of homage.
plain_english: We bow to that supreme Eye of Śiva and Śakti, whose essence is illumination and which possesses all power.
